1\. Nested subdomains stop composing 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Nested blueprint registration no longer inherits a parent subdomain or combines child and parent
subdomains, so routes previously registered for hosts such as v1.api.example are instead
registered for v1.example or no subdomain. Applications using subdomain matching will therefore
fail to match previously valid nested-blueprint requests.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Restore subdomain propagation and composition when registering nested blueprints. A nested blueprint must inherit the parent subdomain when it has none, and its explicit or default subdomain must be prefixed to the parent subdomain. ## Issue Context `BlueprintSetupState` resolves only the blueprint currently being registered, so the parent subdomain must be placed into the child's registration options before recursively calling `blueprint.register`. Preserve precedence between registration options and blueprint defaults, and add coverage for parent-only, child-default, and child-registration subdomains. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py[346-362] - src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py[64-70] - tests/test_blueprints.py[862-908] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
